links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of DR screening AI across benchmark and real-world evaluation settings
links.effect: Substantial variability in sensitivity and specificity across the VA, Finland, and NHS evaluations, despite near-perfect benchmark performance on Messidor-2.
links.quote: Across these evaluation frameworks, substantial variability in observed sensitivity and specificity was found.

links.outcome: Variation in AI performance across sites and imaging devices
links.effect: Differences in imaging devices, population characteristics, referral definitions, and handling of ungradable images contributed to variation in sensitivity and specificity across settings.
links.quote: Differences in imaging devices, population characteristics, referral definitions, and handling of ungradable images contributed to these variations.

unlisted_practices: Standardized evaluation protocols across settings for clinical AI validation
Handling of ungradable images in referral definitions

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a CE-marked diabetic retinopathy diagnostic AI across multiple distinct external frameworks and cohorts, specifically investigating how evaluation framework design and local setting affect performance metrics.

primary.practice: multi-setting external validation and standardized evaluation protocols
